description_for_human: Finished, editable PowerPoint decks from a brief and your documents.
description_for_model: Builds finished, editable PowerPoint decks on the person's Kinsy account from a brief and source text, reports on a deck's progress, and gives links to download or review a finished deck. Use for requests to make a presentation, deck or slides.

functions.name: create_deck
functions.description: Start building a PowerPoint deck from a brief and source text. Spends credits.

confirmation.title: Build this deck with Kinsy?
confirmation.body: Kinsy will build the deck from what you described. It uses credits from your Kinsy account. Do you want to proceed?

functions.name: get_deck
functions.description: Check whether a deck is ready and get its links.

functions.name: export_deck
functions.description: Get a fresh download link for a finished deck.

functions.name: list_themes
functions.description: List the visual themes a deck can use.
